name: hf_trending_monitor
description: HuggingFace model monitor, driven by the Rhai plugin `websites/huggingface.co` (kind: "plugin"). Pass a search phrase or a trending keyword via --query (or state.query); bare (or "trending"/"热门") means the trending feed, anything else is a search. For every model in the current ranking the plugin records rank, likes, downloads, trending score, card metadata (tags / pipeline / license / file list) and downloads the full model card (README) to out_dir (default ~/tmp/hf-trending): snapshot_<key>_<ts>.json, latest_<key>.json, report_<key>_<ts>.md, cards/<id>.md and history.jsonl. Reruns compute a per-model rank delta from latest_<key>.json, so rank moves are visible over time. Optional state: mode (auto|trending|search), limit (1-100, default 10), sort, direction, filter, author, pipeline_tag, out_dir, fetch_cards, tz / tz_offset_minutes (timezone override; by default timestamps are rendered in the local zone of whoever runs the engine). Timestamps are recorded in UTC (created_at / last_modified / fetched_at) and again in the local zone (created_at_local / last_modified_local / fetched_at_local) alongside tz / utc_offset_secs.
